• Upgraded Settings & sub-menus to Full-Screen layout with fluid staggered animations. • Added dedicated About section with Developer credit (Ahmed M Moumen), Version info, and bilingual Changelog. • Standardized project branding to IPTV and Video player.
• Reorganized Settings into clean 2-level categories. • Added interactive Visual Theme Studio with live color swatches and 360ms smooth color morphing.
• Added Favorites (❤️) and Continue Watching (⏱️) sub-tabs inside IPTV Series, Movies & Live TV. • Improved phone edge Back-Swipe navigation across all folders and IPTV screens.
• Added complete IPTV Hub supporting Xtream Codes API and M3U/M3U8 playlists. • Added 280ms debounced instant search in Arabic & English.
• Added bottom Private Vault tab with AndroidKeyStore Biometric & PIN lock. • Added 2-Column Grid / List layout toggle, 7 Sort modes, and NEW video badges.

100% local processing. Vault PINs (PBKDF2 100,000+ iterations) & IPTV credentials (AES-256-GCM) are encrypted on-device via AndroidKeyStore and excluded from cloud backups. No personal data is collected or shared.
VEXO Player (IPTV and Video player) does not collect, transmit, sell, or share any personal data, device identifiers, or media history with external servers.
Video permission (READ_MEDIA_VIDEO) is used strictly on-device to display and play your local video folders. Biometric permission is used locally for Private Vault unlock.

Vault PINs are hashed with PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 (100,000+ iterations) and playlist credentials are encrypted with AES-256-GCM via AndroidKeyStore, excluded from cloud backups. Contact: AHMEDAHMED5547@GMAIL.COM
v90.04 (2026-11-18) — IPTV Auto-Sync, Responsive UI & Rebranding

• Application Name: Renamed application everywhere to IPTV and Video player across launcher, main navigation, About, and internal branding. • Automatic IPTV Background Sync: Automatically refreshes and synchronizes your IPTV library in the background whenever you open the main IPTV section using a subtle top progress bar (removed intrusive server-connection popups). • Uninterrupted Browsing: Navigating between Movies, TV Series, and Live TV or scrolling through channels/streams reuses cached data without triggering repeated refreshes; library re-syncs only when leaving and reopening the main IPTV section. • Unified Sort & Layout Menu: Removed duplicate Sort & Layout controls from Settings, keeping a single clean access point in the top three-line (hamburger) menu. • Responsive Multi-Device Design: Added adaptive layouts, multi-column grids, proportional movie posters, and responsive player controls for smartphones, tablets, and large screens.
v90.03 (2026-11-17) — Google Play Store Readiness & Privacy Policy

• Added full interactive Privacy & Data Security Policy page and legal content disclaimer inside the About section. • Isolated demo IPTV showcase stream strictly to the GitHub flavor so Google Play builds remain 100% pure media players. • Configured modern uncompressed native library alignment (useLegacyPackaging = false) for Android App Bundles (AAB).

• Upgraded Private Vault PIN hashing to PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 (100,000 iterations) with brute-force lockout protection. • Enforced strict AndroidKeyStore AES-256-GCM encryption for IPTV credentials and excluded sensitive caches from cloud backup. • Added FileProvider content URI wrapping for external DLNA/Cast sharing and optional SSL fallback toggle in Settings.
v90.01 (2026-11-16) — Dual Flavor Build & Room SQLite Engine
• Added GitHub and Google Play product flavors with automated unit testing and release signing. • Migrated IPTV stream storage to Room 2.6.1 SQLite database with Paging 3 support for large playlists.

• Restored Stable IPTV Search System: Reverted experimental search changes and restored the fast, stable search engine from the verified baseline. • Section-Restricted Search: Searching inside Movies now searches exclusively within Movies; searching inside TV Series searches exclusively within TV Series; searching inside Live TV searches exclusively within Live TV — never mixing results from other sections. • Instant Live Search While Typing: Search results now update immediately with the first character and every subsequent keystroke without pressing Enter or waiting for delays. • Streamlined 3-Version Changelog: Updated the Changelog system to permanently retain and display only the latest 3 application versions.
v90.05 (2026-11-18) — Keyboard Viewport Resize & Layout Adjustment
• Fixed Android on-screen keyboard interaction (adjustResize & WindowInsetsCompat.Type.ime()) so search results dynamically resize above the keyboard and the last item remains scrollable.
v90.07 (2026-11-18) — Google Play Launch Readiness & Complete Branding

• Complete Application Branding: Unified all internal folders, media session tags, privacy disclosures, and store assets under the official name IPTV and Video player. • Google Play Policy Verification: Verified 100% compliance with Google Play Data Safety, hardware-backed AndroidKeyStore encryption, and isolated Play Store release bundle configuration.
v90.08 — VEXO Player (IPTV and Video player) Official Store Release

• Official Brand Identity: Set primary title to VEXO Player with secondary title IPTV and Video player underneath across the top header, About section, and Google Play Store listing. • Privacy & Contact Integration: Added official developer contact email (AHMEDAHMED5547@GMAIL.COM) and GitHub Privacy Policy URLs across all store and in-app disclosures. • Rolling 3-Version Changelog: Automatically retains only the latest 3 releases (v90.08, v90.07, and v90.06).
v90.09 — Android 16 (API 36) Google Play Target SDK Upgrade

• Android 16 (API Level 36) Compliance: Upgraded targetSdk and compileSdk to 36 to meet Google Play Console upload requirements for security and performance. • Build Compatibility: Preserved full Gradle 8.5 / AGP 8.2.2 green-build compatibility via android.suppressUnsupportedCompileSdk=36. • Rolling 3-Version Changelog: Retains only the latest 3 releases (v90.09, v90.08, and v90.07).
v90.10 — Google Play Release Bundle (Version Code 9010)

• Play Console Release Increment: Incremented versionCode to 9010 with full Android 16 (API 36) target compliance and embedded native debug symbols (debugSymbolLevel = FULL). • Rolling 3-Version Changelog: Retains only the latest 3 releases (v90.10, v90.09, and v90.08).
v%1$s — Luxury Dark UI, Foldable Support & Core Fixes

• Luxury Dark Redesign & Luxury Gold Theme: Refreshed Player Settings and Playback UI with glass panels, thin-line vector icons, glowing SeekBar, monospace timers, and marquee titles. • Full Foldable & Adaptive Support: Added Jetpack WindowManager (Tabletop, Book, Folded Cover, and Unfolded postures) with hinge-safe controls/subtitles and centered large-screen dialogs. • Playback & First-Install Fixes: Rebuilt rotation controls in ConstraintLayout, ported VLC changeSurfaceLayout() to fix Fit-to-Stretch cropping, and added ViewModel + ContentObserver + MediaScanner fallback. • Android 15/16 & Brand Alignment: Enabled edge-to-edge, 16 KB native library alignment (AGP 8.5.1 + LibVLC 3.6.5), unified VEXO Player branding, and 4-version Changelog display.

v%1$s — Audio Library, Android Auto, 2x2 Folder Covers, Material You, Sleep Timer & Audio-Only

• Luxury Dark & Material You: Fixed Luxury Dark theme visibility/persistence, added full Material You dynamic color support & monochrome adaptive icon, and removed redundant App Version item from Settings. • VLC-Style Audio Library & Android Auto: Added Audio tab (Artists, Albums, Tracks, Genres, Room Playlists via MIGRATION_2_3) and Media3 MediaLibraryService for Android Auto with voice search. • 2x2 Folder Cover Collages: Added memory & disk cached 2x2 video frame collages with count badges on video folders. • Enhanced Sleep Timer, Audio Boost (200%) & Audio-Only Background Mode: Added 15–90m/custom/end-of-track sleep timer with 15s fade-out, 16 VLC EQ presets + BassBoost/Virtualizer/LoudnessEnhancer, and seamless video-to-audio background playback.
v%1$s — Theme Picker, PiP Audio-Only & Folder Thumbnails Fix

• Redesigned Theme Picker: 3 clean brightness chips (Follow System, Light, Dark) with Luxury Dark in the theme list and safe migration for old settings.
• Added Headphone (Audio-Only) & Play/Pause action buttons directly on the floating PiP mini player, plus tap-notification-to-resume video.
• Fixed folder 2x2 video collage thumbnails with count badge and representative video frames (internal storage & SD card) with disk + memory caching.
• Redesigned bottom navigation bar to clean Material 3 icon-only tabs (filled active / outlined inactive) with themed pill indicator, TalkBack labels, and long-press tooltips.
